mentions.name: LLM soccer sideline coach game
mentions.description: A web-based soccer game where the player takes the role of a coach whose only possible interaction is shouting — i.e. typing — messages to players from the sidelines. An LLM interprets each typed message and passes the instructions into the game engine.
mentions.source_excerpt: A soccer web game where you are the coach and your only possible interaction is shouting (ie typing) messages to your players from the sidelines. An LLM interpret your messages and pass instructions into the game engine.
